title: Lions and Bears
text:
Lions live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A lion can run very fast, and it sleeps for many hours every day.

Bears live in forests and mountains. Brown bears eat fish, berries and honey. In winter, bears sleep for a long time.

questions.text: What can you infer about how a lion uses its energy?
options: It needs rest after running fast.
It lives alone in a city.

questions.text: What is the main idea of the text?
options: Wild animals live in different places and have different habits.
Lions and bears live in the same forest.

vocabulary.definition: large areas covered with many trees
a sweet, thick food made by bees
the coldest season of the year

paragraph_translations: Леви живуть в Африці. Вони живуть групами, які називаються прайдами. Лев може бігати дуже швидко, і щодня він спить багато годин.
Ведмеді живуть у лісах і горах. Бурі ведмеді їдять рибу, ягоди та мед. Взимку ведмеді сплять довго.
